# Software Foundation

> AI-assisted SaaS starter and engineering toolkit for Next.js/React software. Supports Supabase and independent PostgreSQL. Includes an initial static audit and non-destructive standards adoption.

GitHub: https://github.com/feharo/software-foundation

- [Security and limitations](https://github.com/feharo/software-foundation/blob/main/SECURITY.md)

This file is optional for tools that choose to read it. It is not used by Google as a ranking signal. Generated applications require real configuration; performance audit does not automatically repair code.
